name: TC-460: 'Finalise & charge' with no saved card opens one charge with a payment link, parks the inputs, and refuses a second finalise — nothing is charged twice
description: One SupplyCharge for the basket at $207.00 (within the $258.75 ceiling), collected through the charge's hosted Checkout because the tenant has no saved card. The line stays in the Fulfilment worklist (AWAITING_PAYMENT is still HQ's worklist since RestauNax #1075) with the status 'Waiting on owner payment', with no next step in its menu; History's 'Awaiting payment' filter finds it at the FINAL price. The inputs are parked for the post-payment click, and a second finalise (the old per-line /fulfil route, which now delegates to finalise) is refused AWAITING_OWNER_PAYMENT.
